properties.name: The design is saved one file per node and per edge, with per-item lineage; accepted checksums ride their change; CHANGELOG entries are fragments
properties.rationale: Root cause, walked and measured in step 1 (hub: trials/vscode-call-door-triage-2026-10-02/fix-program/13-step1-recommendation.md): a value derived from something git already merges was stored as one mutable field in a shared committed record — the export's whole-file header (46 of 46 concurrent PR pairs in #640-#668 conflicted on it, 39 on nothing else) and an artifact's checksum on its node (15 of 46). The measured cost is recorded in the live store as fact:approved-prs-serialised-because-each-rewrites-the-whole-export-and-the-changelog-2026-10-03, not yet folded to main, so it is cited here rather than linked. Measured on this branch: main's design written as the item layout is 49,633 item files plus design.json and reassembles to main's own content hash (sha256:3e1f2f2e...); two PRs' records and CHANGELOG fragments merge in either order with plain git to one tree, and compare_designs reads that merge identical to a sequential replay. NOT built here, and why: reflow2_init's conversion of a consumer (cap:a-project-migrates-to-the-item-layout stays planned — flo2 converts in its own PR); the branch overlay (ver:an-overlay-folds-after-a-squash-merge stays planned: the overlay it verifies is not built; the live-store fold it implies is pinned by a new check instead). The single file keeps the whole-file chain and record-only drift check for the one-release overlap. The item layout's committed stamp carries no reflow2_version (decision 5), so its import guard is schema_version, and `materialized` names what a build filled in.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Fix program item 13, step 2 — the build Anthony approved on 2026-10-03 ("yes, go with your recommendation for the 6"). export_graph/--export-to with a directory path writes the item layout (nodes/<Type>/<escaped-id>.json, edges/<xx>/<hash20>.json, design.json with graph_id, schema_version, migrated_from), rewriting only changed files; each changed item's prev_item_hash is its hash at the merge-base; the whole-design hash is computed on read; taken_at goes to a git-ignored sidecar; every reader takes either form (one Rust reader, one Python reader tools/design_io.py for the 39 files that named the path). set_artifact_checksum(s) writes checksum_after/accepted_seq on the accepting change's CHANGED edge and the export elides the node copy it equals. reflow2_check.py checks the layout's integrity and lineage per item and judges design-vs-build per change. CHANGELOG entries are changelog.d fragments assembled at the cut. The .gitattributes merge=reflow2 line came out; AGENTS.md, COORD.md and the parallel-work and ci-gate skills describe both forms. reflow2's own design stays a single file in this PR; tools/convert_design_to_items.py converts main in its own PR (decision 6).
